linh: Quick q — our Node SDK streaming calls return 401 only when API_KEY is set via a systemd service env. Non-streaming requests work fine. Anyone seen trailing CR/LF or hidden chars break Basic auth for streaming connections?
jess: yup. streaming uses a persistent socket and we set the header once; hidden newline in the env makes the header mismatch. can you print the raw bytes? e.g.:

```
# show raw header value
echo -n \"$API_KEY\" | xxd
# or in node
console.log(Buffer.from(process.env.API_KEY || '').toString('hex'))
```

nate: also check if you accidentally included quotes in the systemd unit. `Environment=\"API_KEY=abcd\"` will add literal quotes. use `Environment=API_KEY=abcd` (no quotes) or set from file.

linh: ran xxd — shows a 0d at the end (CR). here's the output i pasted:
```
00000000: 6162 6364 0d                            abcd.
```

jess: yep that's it. for Basic auth the header must be exactly `Basic <base64(username:password)>`. if you base64 encode a value that includes CR it changes the token. streaming reuses the header for the socket handshake so the mismatch causes 401.

nate: quick fixes: trim in the service or in code. systemd unit example: `Environment=API_KEY=abcd` (no trailing newline). or use `EnvironmentFile=/etc/redwood/api_key` making sure the file has no CRLF.

Or ExecStartPre hack if you need to sanitize at startup:
```
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c 'tr -d "\r" < /etc/redwood/api_key > /run/secrets/api_key.cleaned'
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node /app/index.js
EnvironmentFile=/run/secrets/api_key.cleaned
```

linh: thanks — i applied `tr -d "\r"` and restarted, streaming auth works now. one follow-up: i still saw a disconnect mid-request once. any common causes?

jess: if you ever see a `00` byte in the hex that's a NUL — that will definitely break header parsing for some libs. also check SDK debug logs, enable `DEBUG=redwood:client:stream` and paste the handshake logs. chunked encoding issues can look like disconnects but usually the auth/header bytes are the culprit.

nate: in-node defensive pattern we use: `const key = (process.env.API_KEY || '').replace(/[\r\n\0]/g, ''); const header = 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(`${key}:`).toString('base64');` — strips CR/LF/NUL before encoding.

devex-bot: FYI docs: https://redwood.example/docs/auth#common-env-pitfalls — has a checklist (systemd, docker, windows CRLFs).

linh: fixed it by sanitizing both in systemd and in code (`replace(/[\r\n\0]/g, '')`) — streaming + retries stable now. thanks all! :thumbsup:
